title: Sebuah Nama
alt: Dua sapuan pigmen lembut merah muda dan safron yang nyaris bersentuhan di atas kertas pucat
concept: An intimate minimal watercolor abstraction on pale blush cotton rag paper. Two tiny irregular pools of translucent saffron and dusty-rose pigment bloom toward each other near the lower third. A single delicate rust-colored thread curves from one to the other, stopping just short. Most of the image is quiet soft pink negative space; capillary pigment edges, pale diluted washes, a faint wet-paper halo. The first small chance of recognizing another person. Extremely restrained, light, tender and airy; no black charcoal, no dense collage, no central spiral.
